sourceFile: 54.1. BRS-161014  Report checking NTI of test Frame improvement type C date 24.10.2023_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft detects a Normal vs Test NTI frame-improvement comparison but its changed factor and outcome grouping are not reliable.
issues: Changed factor is copied from filename instead of defined as Normal vs Test frame improvement type C.
Baseline and changed conditions are marked not explicit despite Normal/Test evidence.
FO outcome stats are misparsed from row indices rather than FO values.
SPL/THD/IMP outcomes are not grouped into valid Normal/Test/ST comparisons.
Evidence relies on headers and partial FO rows, not sufficient metric data rows.
requiredUserQuestions: Confirm whether Normal is baseline and Test is frame improvement type C.
Confirm whether ST is only a reference condition or part of the comparison.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to Normal frame vs Test frame improvement type C.
Define Normal as baseline and Test as changed condition; keep ST as reference if confirmed.
Re-extract FO using actual TEST, NORMAL, and ST values by sample number.
Group SPL, THD, IMP, and FO under one validation report with proper metric rows.
Cite header plus representative data or summary rows for each metric domain.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations are semantically insufficient for final evidence.
